Carabao Cup quarter-final draw: Liverpool host Bournemouth as Bradford and Fleetwood get home ties against Premier League opposition
Carabao Cup quarter-final draw as Liverpool to face Bournemouth; League One Bradford City and League Two Fleetwood Town both get homes ties against Premier League opposition; games will be played on week of December 14
Wednesday 28 October 2026 23:03, UK
Liverpool will play Bournemouth in the Carabao Cup quarter-finals while League One Bradford City will host Manchester City.
Fleetwood Town's reward for knocking out Premier League champions Arsenal is a home game against the winner of Everton vs Newcastle on Thursday night.
Crystal Palace will host Sunderland in an all-Premier League clash in the remaining last-eight tie.
- Transfer Centre LIVE! | Latest EFL news and rumours
- Got Sky? Watch the Carabao Cup LIVE on your phone📱
- Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream the Carabao Cup with no contract📺
Liverpool beat Chelsea on penalties to set up a meeting with Andoni Iraola's former side Bournemouth, who went through to the quarter-finals in style with a fine 3-0 win against Aston Villa.
Manchester City also needed penalties to earn victory against Brighton. Their opponents, Bradford, beat Peterborough 2-0.
Eddie Nketiah got the only goal of the game as Palace won at Fulham.
Sunderland also beat Premier League opposition to take their place in the next round as they overcame Brentford 3-2.
The quarter-finals of the Carabao Cup will take place during the week commencing December 14.
Carabao Cup quarter-final draw in full...
Fleetwood Town vs Everton/Newcastle
Manchester City vs Bradford
Crystal Palace vs Sunderland
Liverpool vs Bournemouth
Ties to be played week commencing December 14
digest_he:
הגרלת רבע גמר גביע הליגה האנגלי זימנה מפגש ביתי לליברפול שתארח את בורנמות. מנצ'סטר סיטי, שגברה בבעיטות הכרעה על ברייטון, תצא למשחק חוץ מול ברדפורד סיטי מהליגה השלישית.

פליטווד טאון, שהדיחה את אלופת הפרמייר ליג ארסנל, תזכה לארח במשחק ביתי את המנצחת בין אברטון לניוקאסל. במסגרת משחק נוסף בשלב רבע הגמר, תארח קריסטל פאלאס את סנדרלנד למפגש על טהרת הפרמייר ליג.

משחקי רבע הגמר של הטורניר יתקיימו במהלך השבוע שמתחיל ב-14 בדצמבר.
